name: bayes
description: Exact Bayesian updating: prior + hit rate + specificity gives the true posterior with the odds/likelihood-ratio working shown (the 1%-prior/99%/95% test yields 16.67%, not 99%). Sequential 'update belief' requests chain the posterior; degenerate evidence that cannot move the posterior is refused.
route: bayes: prior 1% sensitivity 99% specificity 95%, update belief: hit rate 90% false positive 10%, posterior with prior 0.02
